intro.text: Sustainable Development Goal 4 (SDG 4) seeks to "Ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all." Education is the foundation for sustainable social, economic, and environmental development. Higher education institutions play a significant role in producing skilled professionals, promoting innovation, advancing research, and creating responsible citizens capable of addressing global challenges.

Kalinga University, located at Kotni, Naya Raipur, Chhattisgarh, is committed to providing high-quality, inclusive, and multidisciplinary education aligned with the vision of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 and the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. The University strives to nurture academic excellence through innovative teaching methodologies, industry-oriented curricula, experiential learning, research, entrepreneurship, and community engagement.

The University offers undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, and doctoral programmes across Engineering, Management, Pharmacy, Agriculture, Science, Commerce, Law, Arts and Humanities, Education, Information Technology, Nursing, Allied Health Sciences, and other emerging disciplines. Through its modern infrastructure, qualified faculty, digital learning ecosystem, industry collaborations, and student-centric policies, Kalinga University continuously enhances the quality of education and lifelong learning opportunities.

The University integrates academic knowledge with practical skills through internships, industrial training, field visits, laboratory-based learning, project work, value-added certification programmes, and skill development initiatives. These efforts ensure that graduates possess professional competence, ethical values, leadership qualities, and entrepreneurial abilities required to contribute effectively to society.

Kalinga University also emphasizes research and innovation through dedicated research centres, funded research projects, patents, incubation facilities, faculty development programmes, and collaborations with national and international institutions. These initiatives promote knowledge creation and support evidence-based solutions to regional, national, and global challenges.

The University is equally committed to inclusive education by providing scholarships, financial assistance, mentoring, counselling, equal opportunity initiatives, gender sensitization programmes, and facilities for differently-abled students. These measures ensure equitable access to quality education regardless of socioeconomic background.

In addition, Kalinga University actively promotes digital education through Learning Management Systems (LMS), smart classrooms, virtual laboratories, online learning platforms, digital library resources, MOOCs, and blended learning approaches. These digital initiatives strengthen teaching-learning processes while preparing students for the rapidly evolving technological landscape.

By integrating quality teaching, impactful research, innovation, community outreach, entrepreneurship, and lifelong learning, Kalinga University contributes significantly towards achieving United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 4—Quality Education.

sections.title: 4.1. Research on early years and lifelong learning education

blocks.text: The SDG 4-aligned research publications of Kalinga University have received significant academic recognition and visibility, reflecting the University's commitment to advancing quality education, innovative teaching practices, and educational research. The increasing readership, citations, and scholarly engagement highlight the relevance of the University's contributions in areas such as pedagogy, curriculum development, digital learning, skill enhancement, inclusive education, and lifelong learning. These research outcomes demonstrate Kalinga University's efforts in generating evidence-based knowledge that supports educational transformation, promotes effective learning methodologies, strengthens capacity building, and contributes to the global discourse on Sustainable Development Goal 4 (Quality Education). Through interdisciplinary research and academic innovation, the University continues to support accessible, equitable, and quality education while fostering lifelong learning opportunities for diverse communities.
4.1.1. Quality Education: paper views

Kalinga University contributes to Quality Education through impactful research publications in internationally recognized Scopus-indexed journals. The increasing views and academic engagement of these research papers reflect the relevance and visibility of the University's contributions in education, interdisciplinary studies, innovation, and knowledge advancement. These scholarly outcomes demonstrate the University's commitment to research excellence, global academic collaboration, and the generation of evidence-based knowledge.
4.1.2 Quality Education: Cite Score

Kalinga University demonstrates a significant research contribution towards Sustainable Development Goal 4 (SDG 4): Quality Education. During the period 2021–2025, the University published 67 research papers, receiving 103 citations, which reflect the scholarly visibility and impact of its research in the field of education. These publications highlight the University's research efforts in areas such as educational innovation, effective teaching-learning practices, inclusive education, skill development, and lifelong learning. Through research and knowledge dissemination, Kalinga University continues to contribute to the advancement of educational practices and the promotion of accessible, equitable, and quality education. Overall, the University's research performance during 2021–2025 demonstrates its commitment to generating knowledge and supporting the achievement of SDG 4: Quality Education.
4.1.3 Quality Education: publications

Kalinga University published 67 SDG 4-aligned research papers, receiving 103 citations, highlighting its commitment to quality education, inclusive learning, digital education, educational innovation, teacher development, and lifelong learning.

This exceptional research performance highlights not only the quality and relevance of the University's educational research but also its growing academic influence in addressing contemporary educational challenges at regional, national, and global levels. The sustained impact of these publications underscores Kalinga University's leadership in generating evidence-based educational practices, supporting policy formulation, promoting innovative teaching and learning methodologies, fostering equitable access to quality education, and contributing significantly to the achievement of Sustainable Development Goal 4 (Quality Education) and sustainable societal development.

sections.title: 4.2. Proportion of graduates with teaching qualification

blocks.text: Kalinga University is committed to developing qualified educators by providing opportunities for graduates to acquire recognized teaching qualifications and professional training. These initiatives enhance pedagogical skills, subject expertise, and teaching competencies, contributing to the preparation of skilled education professionals who support quality teaching, inclusive learning, and lifelong educational development.
4.2.1 Indicator: Proportion of graduates with relevant qualification for teaching

Kalinga University, Naya Raipur, is committed to preparing qualified educators who contribute to strengthening the education sector in alignment with Sustainable Development Goal 4 (Quality Education). During the reporting period, 80 graduates possessing a Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.) qualification are employed as teachers in schools, demonstrating the University's success in producing professionally qualified educators. These graduates are equipped with pedagogical knowledge, subject expertise, classroom management skills, and ethical teaching practices required for effective school education. Their placement in schools reflects the University's emphasis on quality teacher education, employability, and capacity building, while contributing to inclusive, equitable, and high-quality education and supporting the development of a skilled teaching workforce.
4.2.1 Graduates with teaching qualification

A total of 155 B.Ed., B.P. Ed and M.Ed. Graduates successfully qualified All are demonstrating their competence to meet teaching standards at both the national and state levels and reflecting readiness for state school teaching positions enhancing their eligibility for central government and other affiliated schools across India. These achievements demonstrate the effectiveness of the University's teacher education programme in developing pedagogical knowledge, professional skills, and subject expertise. The consistent success of graduates in these competitive examinations reflects Kalinga University's commitment to producing competent, employable, and professionally qualified teachers who contribute to strengthening the quality of school education in alignment with Sustainable Development Goal 4 (Quality Education).

blocks.text: Kalinga University promotes lifelong learning through diverse academic, vocational, and skill development initiatives designed to support continuous personal and professional growth. The University conducts certificate courses, workshops, training programmes, seminars, and capacity-building activities that enhance employability, digital literacy, entrepreneurship, and professional competencies. These initiatives provide learners with opportunities for continuous knowledge enhancement and skill upgradation, supporting inclusive education and Sustainable Development Goal 4 (Quality Education). The initiatives are as follows:

Skill Development Workshop: Conducted vocational skill development workshops to enhance participants' technical competencies, employability, and entrepreneurial capabilities through practical, industry-oriented training and hands-on learning experiences.

Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP): Organized entrepreneurship development programmes to promote innovation, business planning, financial literacy, and self-employment opportunities among students and community participants.

Digital Skills Training: Delivered digital literacy and ICT training programmes to strengthen participants' technological proficiency, communication skills, and readiness for modern workplace requirements.

Industrial Training and Internships: Facilitated industrial training and internship programmes providing practical exposure, professional skills, and industry experience to improve career readiness and lifelong learning outcomes.

Career Readiness Programme: Conducted career guidance and employability training covering aptitude, soft skills, interview techniques, resume writing, and professional development for diverse learners.

Hands-on Technical Training: Organized practical technical training sessions enabling participants to acquire job-oriented competencies through laboratory practice, demonstrations, and experiential learning methodologies.

Financial Literacy Programme: Implemented financial literacy workshops focusing on budgeting, banking, digital payments, savings, and entrepreneurship to promote informed financial decision-making and economic empowerment.

Agricultural and Rural Skill Training: Conducted vocational training on sustainable agriculture, modern farming practices, and agri-entrepreneurship to improve livelihoods and rural economic development.

Women Skill Empowerment Programme: Organized vocational skill training for women to strengthen self-employment opportunities, financial independence, and inclusive socioeconomic development through lifelong learning initiatives.

Community Vocational Outreach: Extended vocational education programmes for local communities through workshops, expert sessions, and practical demonstrations, fostering continuous skill enhancement and lifelong learning opportunities.
4.3.1 Public resources (lifelong learning)

Kalinga University promotes responsible utilization and management of public resources through transparent administrative practices, efficient resource allocation, and sustainable use of institutional facilities. The University ensures optimal utilization of infrastructure, learning resources, digital facilities, and shared services while encouraging accountability, conservation, and equitable access for students, faculty, and stakeholders. These practices support effective governance and sustainable institutional development.

Central Instrumentation Facility (CIF): To fulfil the research needs in science and technology at a higher level, Central Instrumentation Facility (CIF) are established at Kalinga University for students, faculty members, and research scholars. A wide range of advanced instruments, including an X-Ray Diffractometer (XRD), 3D Printer, Bio-Chemistry Analyser, and many more, are available for in-depth experimentation work under one roof. We also welcome researchers from other universities, organisations, and NGOs, promoting collaboration across different departments.

Managed by a team of technical experts, KU ensures that researchers are well-supported through hands-on training programs and workshops, which not only teach them how to operate an instrument but also ways to analyse and manage data effectively. We aim to expand our sophisticated list of machines to become a National Leader in research excellence.

blocks.text: Quality Education through Academic and Professional Development Activities

KU-Hackathon 2025 provided students with a collaborative platform to solve real-world challenges through innovation and technology. The event strengthened problem-solving, teamwork, and digital competencies, promoting experiential learning. IDEATHON 5.0 encouraged students to develop innovative business ideas and entrepreneurial skills through healthy competition. The event nurtured creativity, critical thinking, and leadership, supporting quality education. The Guest lecture on “Recent Advances in Marine Sciences: Seaweeds as a Millennium Resource for Sustainable Applications “exposed students to emerging research on marine biodiversity and sustainable applications of seaweeds. It enhanced scientific awareness and interdisciplinary learning, contributing to knowledge-based education. The Guest lecture highlighted the contribution of industries toward India's vision of Viksit Bharat and sustainable economic development. Students gained practical insights into industry-academia collaboration and employability. This expert session enhanced students' understanding of viral infections, diagnostic techniques, and public health challenges. The lecture promoted scientific learning and professional competence, supporting inclusive and quality higher education.

The Guest lecture “Recent Trends in Power Distribution System” introduced students to modern developments in electrical power distribution, including smart grid technologies and energy efficiency. It strengthened technical knowledge and industry readiness. Online Quiz Competition on the “Constitution of India: Foundation, Rights and Governance” The online quiz promoted constitutional literacy and awareness of fundamental rights, duties, and governance among students. By encouraging informed and responsible citizenship. Guest Lecture on "Unlocking Innovations: Exploring Patents, Designs and Intellectual Property Rights”. The guest lecture familiarized students with patents, industrial designs, and intellectual property rights, encouraging innovation and research ethics. The session strengthened awareness of knowledge protection and innovation-driven learning, contributing to SDG 4: Quality Education.

blocks.text: Collaborative Library Resource Sharing

The Central Library provides authorized access and resource-sharing services to collaborating Universities, institutions, faculty members, researchers, and research scholars, subject to applicable copyright laws, licence agreements, subscription terms, and institutional MoUs.

Key resources include LexisNexis, Scopus, international newspapers, DELNET resources, Union Catalogues Library and selected print/e-resources of the Central Library. Access is provided strictly for academic, teaching, learning, and research purposes, with restrictions on unauthorized downloading, reproduction, redistribution, or commercial use in accordance with applicable copyright and licensing conditions.
4.3.2 Public events (lifelong learning)

Kalinga University actively organizes public events that promote education, skill development, health awareness, and community engagement. The Teaching Learning Material (TLM) Exhibition provides a platform for showcasing innovative educational tools and creative teaching methodologies, encouraging experiential learning and academic excellence. The Mega Placement Drive connects students with industry opportunities, enhancing employability, career development, and professional growth. The celebration of International Yoga Day promotes physical fitness, mental well-being, and awareness about the importance of yoga and holistic health practices among students, faculty, and the wider community. These initiatives reflect the University's commitment to social responsibility, inclusive participation, and Sustainable Development Goals.

blocks.text: Professional Certification and Capacity Building Programmes

Kalinga University actively promotes lifelong learning and professional development by organizing specialized certification and training programmes. During 2025, the University conducted an Advanced Certification Course on Artificial Intelligence and Cyber-Security: Emerging Legal and Technical Issues and a Trainers' Training Certification Course on the Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) Act, 2013, organized by the Faculty of Law in association with the Indian National Bar Association (INBA), New Delhi. Conducted over one month on weekends, these programmes enhanced participants' legal, technical, and professional competencies. The University also hosted the NCC 'C' Certificate Examination on 15–16 February 2025 in collaboration with NCC 8 CG Girls Battalion, Kota, strengthening leadership, discipline, and national service among cadets.

The workshop focused on strengthening teaching competencies, improving classroom communication, and developing effective pedagogical practices among educators and prospective teachers. Through expert-led sessions, participants explored various micro-teaching skills designed to make teaching more effective, engaging, and learner-centred. The Skill Development Workshop on Micro Teaching contributed to the objectives of SDG 4 by promoting teacher training, enhancing pedagogical skills, and encouraging continuous improvement in educational practices. Through international collaborations, diverse learning opportunities, and a multicultural campus ecosystem, Kalinga University supports equal access to quality education and contributes to Sustainable Development Goal 4 (Quality Education).
